thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 06/08/2018: AAPL, QCOM, BABA

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 06/08/2018: AAPL, QCOM, BABA
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.3%
AAPL: -1.3%
IBM: -0.5%
CSCO: -0.4%
GOOG: -1.2%
Technology shares were in negative territory ahead of Friday's open.
Expected movers:
- Apple ( AAPL ): the Nikkei Asian Review said the company has asked its supply chain to prepare around 20% fewer components than in the year-ago period for iPhones debuting in the latter half of 2018
- Alibaba ( BABA ): affiliate Ant Financial said early Friday it has entered into definitive agreements with investors for a $14 billion series C equity financing
Other news:
- Qualcomm ( QCOM ): extended its cash tender offer period to acquire all outstanding shares of NXP Semiconductors ( NXPI ) to a new expiry date of June 15
